0022600162.text: The Orlando Magic (2-4, 9th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 1 game back) host the Washington Wizards (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) in Orlando's seventh game of the season, with the Magic 0-3 at home and coming off a loss while Washington has won its last game. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Izaiyah Nelson, all listed as out, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, and Tristan Vukcevic, also out, and Alex Sarr and Anthony Gill are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Orlando won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-131 win on March 12, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
